description: Comfort-envelope V3 with a causal V2G sensitivity capped at 5% of each province-day baseline EV peak.

parameter_status.thermal_power_envelope: Power_curve_V2 BAIT and balance-point formula with +/-1 C setpoint sensitivity; not an indoor-temperature calibration
parameter_status.thermal_state: province-generic equivalent thermal state; duration and retention require low/base/high sensitivity
parameter_status.ev_v1g: uncontrolled charging baseline with aggregate 12-hour latest-service deadline; plug availability is not observed
parameter_status.v2g_power: 5% of province-day uncontrolled EV peak is an explicit conservative sensitivity, not a mandated fleet participation rate
parameter_status.v2g_state: daily zero causal deviation state requires charge before discharge and preserves driving-energy service through V1G accounting
parameter_status.v2g_compensation: 608 CNY/MWh central battery-degradation anchor; test 300-1100 CNY/MWh
